description: This file contains functions for analyzing behavioral observation data, including inter-rater reliability (Cohen's Kappa), sequence similarity (Needleman-Wunsch), and related analysis tools within the BORIS software. It interacts with a database of aggregated events and provides GUI dialogs for user input.

methods.name: subj_behav_modif
methods.description: Retrieves current behaviors for a specific observation, subject, and time, optionally including modifiers, from the database.

methods.name: cohen_kappa
methods.description: Calculates Cohen's Kappa coefficient for inter-rater reliability between two observations over a specified interval and subjects.

methods.name: irr_cohen_kappa
methods.description: Performs inter-rater reliability analysis across multiple observations using Cohen's Kappa, with GUI prompts for user input.

methods.name: needleman_wunsch_identity
methods.description: Computes sequence similarity (identity score) between two observations using the Needleman-Wunsch algorithm.

methods.name: needleman_wunch
methods.description: Calculates sequence similarity for multiple observations using the Needleman-Wunsch algorithm, with GUI prompts.
